data.name: R.override
data.detailed_description:
R.override is a discovery-driven survival game where you drive an expendable rover unit, dispatched to a beautiful yet hostile alien world, in search of lost survivors. The further you explore, the more you'll unravel a strange secret buried beneath the surface.

Survival-Exploration

Energy is a scarce resource in this unforgiving environment. Whenever your rover breaks down, a new unit arrives on the planet immediately. Every breakdown is a fresh start with new paths to push forward with a better understanding of the planet's challenges.

A Vibrant Alien World Awaits

Master physics-based driving mechanics as you pilot the rover across a variety of terrains in multiple distinct biomes. Learn to navigate the planet’s strange flora and fauna and adapt your playstyle to the new challenges you will encounter.

Adapt and Upgrade

Scavenge blueprints to unlock new abilities and customize your loadout with each new attempt. Equip your rover with tools like a grappling hook, a nitro boost, or a shield barrier. But be careful, because every modification costs precious energy, too.

Stylized Retro Sci-Fi 

The art team behind the style of The Berlin Apartment pushes its signature comic-book aesthetics even further in this colorful, Moebius-inspired semi-open world full of secrets.

English*, French, Italian, German, Spanish - Spain, Portuguese - Brazil, Simplified Chinese, Japanese, Korean, Russian, Thai, Turkish, Ukrainian
*languages with full audio support

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • OS: Windows 10 64-Bit
  • Processor: AMD Phenom II X4 965, 3.40 GHz / Intel Core i5-2300, 2.80 GHz
  • Graphics: Radeon RX 560, 4 GB / GeForce GTX 960, 4GB
  • DirectX: Version 10
  • Storage: 15 GB available space
